void os_loop_iteration(void){g_tick_ms+=LOOP_MS; for(uint8_t c=0;c<CHANS;c++){int16_t av=os_hal_comm_available(c); while(av-->0){char ch=os_hal_comm_read(c); if(cmdl[c]<OS_MAX_COMMAND_LENGTH)cmd[c][cmdl[c]++]=ch; else cmdl[c]=0; if(ch==OS_LX200_CMD_SUFFIX){char rb[OS_MAX_REPLY_LENGTH];size_t rl=0;os_error_t e=os_command_parse(cmd[c],cmdl[c],c,rb,sizeof rb,&rl); if(e!=OS_ERR_NONE&&rl==0)reply(rb,sizeof rb,&rl,"0#"); (void)os_hal_comm_write(c,rb,rl); cmdl[c]=0;}}} for(uint8_t a=0;a<AXES;a++)if(os_hal_limit_is_triggered(a)&&(g_goto_active||g_manual_active||g_park_active)){set_fault_stop(a);return;} for(uint8_t a=0;a<AXES;a++)host_advance_motor(a); motion_complete_check(); os_site_info_t s; if(os_hal_gps_poll(&s)==OS_ERR_NONE&&s.valid){g_site=s;g_gps_locked=true;} update_tracking();}
